## Mapped classes

No class is mapped at skos:closeMatch or stronger in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Formulate, justify and execute public budgets across appropriations cycles — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Brief decision-makers and elected officials for authoritative decisions — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Design developmental work experiences that preserve the formation of professional judgment — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Elicit, document and transfer tacit and institutional knowledge before people leave — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L4
- Design and administer cross-jurisdictional stewardship agreements — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Assess the durability and reversal risk of policy choices and time actions to policy windows — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L5
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L4
- Govern enterprise environmental data and AI portfolios — lead L4, strategic L5
- Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L4
- Navigate legislative and governing-body processes for environmental programs — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Apply systems thinking across ecological, institutional and technical systems — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L4
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Develop proposals and grant applications for environmental work — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L3
- Specify, evaluate and accept AI and analytics services in procurement — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L3
- Design human-in-the-loop review for AI-assisted environmental workflows — lead L3, strategic L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — senior L2, lead L2, strategic L3
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — senior L2, lead L3, strategic L4
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — senior L2, lead L3, strategic L3
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — senior L2, lead L2, strategic L3
- Conduct job analyses and write job-related assessments for technical positions — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Justify positions and staffing with workload and mission evidence — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Scan horizons and translate change signals into workforce decisions — strategic L4
- Set programme strategy and lead organizational and technological change in environmental programmes — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Run the adaptive management cycle and evaluate programme performance — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Communicate technical environmental information in writing and speech — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Apply merit-based, job-related practices in recruitment and team management — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Develop and compare policy and land-use scenarios for environmental decisions — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
